title: Renovations and relationships
html:
This weekend saw the start of ‘Stage Two’ of our house renovation. Exciting stuff but often the stuff that relationship nightmares are made of… not only with your better half (if you're a male) but also with family, friends and contractors.

How to keep it all running smoothly? Especially when everyone has their own idea of what is best and is quite happy to voice their opinion – loudly, if need be.

One thing I learnt this weekend is what not to do when my girl is there - DEMOLITION. Great stuff if you’re a guy, horrifying if you’re a girl. For a guy, the satisfaction (and danger) as a brick chimney comes tumbling down is great. For a girl, walking into the room you spent a day painting that now has cracks in the wall, means time to go for a walk or maybe for a coffee with your girlfriends.

So what has this got to do with you this morning, apart from the fact that you're probably smiling right now?

Relationships come in all shapes and sizes and, like houses, need a little renovation every now and then. Sometimes it might be as simple as a meal and a DVD together, an email to a client to let them know you're there for them, or a card to show you appreciate someone.

Have a terrific week and maybe do a bit of renovation on some of your relationships.
